verses.1: And I saw from the sea a monster rising up. It had ten horns and seven heads. On its horns there were ten names of blasphemy. And on its heads there were also names of blasphemy.
verses.2: And the monster we saw was similar to a dragon. Its legs were like those of an ark, and its mouth was like that of a lion. The dragon gave it its power, its throne, and great authority.
verses.3: And one of his heads was cut off, as if it had been eaten by a monster. But the wound that caused his death was healed. And all the earth marveled at this miracle.
verses.4: And they bowed down before the dragon, because it had given them authority over that monster. They said to the monster, “Who is like this monster? Who can fight against it?”
verses.5: And he was given the authority to speak in a loud voice and to utter insults. He also was given the authority to act for forty-two months.
verses.6: And he opened his mouth in mockery towards the god; he mocked his name and his place in heaven.
verses.7: And he was given the power to wage war against the saints and to defeat them. He also received authority over all tribes, peoples, languages, and nations.
verses.8: And they will all worship him, those who live on this earth. His name is not written in the book of life, which contains the names of those who were sacrificed from the sky.
verses.9: If anyone has anything to say, please speak up.
verses.10: If anyone is in a state of suffering, then he must endure it; if someone is wounded by a sword, then he must also endure the pain. This is what endurance and faith of the saints mean.
verses.11: And I saw another monster rising from the ground. It had two horns that were similar to those of a deer. It also screamed like a dragon.
verses.12: And he gives the first beast all authority over it. He also makes the earth and those who live in it worship that first beast, after it has been healed from its deathly wound.
verses.13: And it creates great signs, so that even fire can descend from heaven onto the earth, right before people’s eyes.
verses.14: And he also scattered those who lived on the ground, using the signs that were given to him to do so before the monster. He told those who lived on the ground to create an image of the monster, which had been wounded by a sword and was dying.
verses.15: And it was given to him to give life to the image of the monster, so that the image of the monster could speak and do whatever it wanted. Those who did not worship the image of the monster would be punished accordingly.
verses.16: And he does this for everyone, for the small and the big, for the rich and the poor, for the free and the slaves, so that they may have a mark on their right hand or on their forehead.
verses.17: And so that no one may buy or sell it, unless they have the right to do so. They must also know the name of the animal, as well as its number.
verses.18: Is this indeed wisdom? One who has knowledge will be able to determine the number of that beast. After all, that number is the number of humans. And its number is six hundred and fifty-six.
